title: Inference for High-Dimensional Network Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.26522v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a novel method of inference for network-dependent high-dimensional random vectors. Dependence is characterized via a functional dependence measure based on graph distance, allowing the approximation theory to capture the interaction between the decay of dependence and the growth of network neighborhoods. We establish Gaussian approximation results for the maximum norm under finite-moment and sub-Weibull conditions, providing explicit conditions under which the dimension may increase with the network size. We also propose a high-dimensional network HAC covariance estimator and establish its convergence properties, yielding a feasible procedure for simultaneous inference. Simulation studies demonstrate favorable finite-sample performance of the proposed method. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26522v1 公告类型：新公告  摘要：我们开发了一种针对网络依赖的高维随机向量的新型推断方法。依赖性通过基于图距离的函数依赖度量来表征，使得近似理论能够捕捉依赖性衰减与网络邻域增长之间的相互作用。我们在有限矩和次威布尔条件下建立了最大范数的高斯近似结果，提供了维度可能随网络规模增长而增加的明确条件。我们还提出了一种高维网络HAC协方差估计器，并建立了其收敛性质，从而为同时推断提供了可行的程序。模拟研究展示了所提出方法良好的有限样本性能。我们将该程序应用于研究溢出效应如何随网络同质性指数变化，通过构建条件溢出效应函数的置信带。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对网络依赖高维随机向量的推断方法，基于图距离的函数依赖度量，建立了高斯近似和网络HAC协方差估计，并应用于溢出效应的置信带分析。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a novel inference method for network-dependent high-dimensional random vectors, using graph-distance-based functional dependence, establishing Gaussian approximation and network HAC covariance estimation, and applying it to confidence bands for spillover effects.
